items.question: Which iPhones does Reperoo work with?
items.answer: Reperoo is built for iPhones with a USB-C port: iPhone 15 and later. Support for Lightning iPhones with an adapter is still being looked at.

items.question: Which drives can I use?
items.answer: Most USB-C SSDs and flash drives. Format the drive as exFAT on a computer first: FAT32 can't hold files over 4 GB, and Reperoo can't write to a read-only drive.

items.question: Does Reperoo upload my photos anywhere?
items.answer: No. There's no account, no server and no tracking. Your photos are read on your iPhone and written to your drive, and nowhere else.

items.question: How does Move keep my photos safe?
items.answer: Each file is hashed while it's written, read back from the drive and hashed again, then checked once more right before anything is deleted. Only files that pass all three are deleted, through iOS's own confirmation, and they stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

items.question: Do I get my original files?
items.answer: Yes. Reperoo copies the originals (HEIC, JPEG, RAW, HEVC and ProRes) with their metadata, and keeps both halves of a Live Photo together.

items.question: What if a file with the same name is already on the drive?
items.answer: You choose, just like in Finder: keep both, overwrite or skip. Reperoo never overwrites a file without asking.

items.question: Is it a subscription?
items.answer: No. Reperoo is a single one-time purchase of €3.50. Pay once and it's yours, with no renewals and no ads.
